packageRules.description: pyproject.toml pins the dependencies: each PR rewrites a pin, so uv locks exactly the version the PR names
Python upgrades are done by hand, cf. CHANGELOG_breaking_changes.md: requires-python and the setup-python versions
The images of the workflow services (postgis, redis) follow production by hand, PostgreSQL 17 in particular
Our own library, no need to wait
Only renames group:boto of config:recommended, which groups boto3 with the botocore it requires: boto is another package
We need rsa signing compatibility, see https://github.com/gip-inclusion/les-emplois/pull/8071
Django feature releases need a planned upgrade: open their PR from the Dependency Dashboard
